sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully encodes the direct-static conditional requirement: when shipOperatesInPolarWaters is explicitly true, all three required ship-owned document-coverage properties must be explicitly true; otherwise no coverage constraint is imposed. Canonical terms, target, datatypes, namespace, and applicability boundary are valid.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Remove the false applicability alternative that requires shipOperatesInPolarWaters to exist and equal false; the requirement imposes no obligation when the ship does not operate in polar waters, so missing applicability evidence must not be treated as compliant or require an explicit false value.
